Default layout `box-compact` at `top-center`, which has no equivalent here, so position is only set when it maps. Policy URL comes from `privacyPageCustomUrl` or `privacyPageUrl`. Banner text is `entranceDescription` (localized). Geo-IP and "hide dialog on pages" exist, so only ask everyone first when both are off.

- **Page tokens**: `[borlabs-cookie type="btn-consent-preferences"]` (legacy `btn-cookie-preference`) → Cookie settings button. `type="service-list"` / `cookie-list` → Cookie policy block.
